modules.name: game_pokedex
modules.purposeLead: Pokédex entity and location action surface

payloadInspection.scope: installed client resources and owner-authorized roaming configuration snapshot
observations: The installed module resources are protected or nonstandard and did not yield readable location-query code or a structured payload.
The roaming configuration contains Pokémon profile/move state and Minimap.flags records, but no Pokémon-to-coordinate relation was identified.
Binary string hits were limited to executables/libraries and were not treated as an inspectable data source.
payloadInspection.boundary: No protection bypass, client modification, execution-time interception or credential/session inspection was used.

interpretation: Module names and UI assets prove client affordances, not the existence or shape of a local Pokémon coordinate dataset.
nextEvidence: capture a permitted client-visible Pokédex location lookup, identify a public data endpoint/resource used by the lookup, or record a reviewed player contribution
